basis: PMT Summary Notes used as a coverage checklist alongside the AQA 8525 specification for first exams in 2027. Explanations and examples are newly written, not a reproduction of PMT wording or artwork.

decisions: Bus/star topology detail is not specified in the revised 2027 content and is not imported as mandatory coverage. A LAN has no fixed small-device limit; speed is not a defining network type.

added_or_developed: Original two-device diagram showing sender down-stack, network transfer and receiver up-stack
decisions: Required protocol list follows AQA: TCP, IP, HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, IMAP. UDP and FTP in the source are not added as required named protocols. Wi-Fi is not expanded as Wireless Fidelity.

added_or_developed: Concrete filtering examples and combined defences
decisions: No absolute claim that a cable guarantees privacy or that a factory MAC address cannot be changed.

verification: All reading groups checked at 1366, 390 and 320 pixels
Images load, tables have consistent columns, source section hidden, no page overflow
Original source content and recent comparison tables retained; updated content checked against AQA 2027 specification

diagram_review.learning_purpose: Shows communication direction and the jobs/protocols at corresponding layers on two devices.
diagram_review.review: Rendered and visually inspected; arrows, layer order, protocol assignments and label clearance checked.

spacing_revision.change: Smaller blocks and wider gaps; restrained heading sizes; capped reader width; mobile horizontal scrolling retains readable labels rather than squeezing both stacks.
